## Security Deposit Disposition - entry point
Trigger: Leases.Security Deposit Disposition = Prepare, pushed by the Airtable watcher "n8n push | Leases state changed" through the Event Dispatcher (leases branch). No schedule, by design: a missed push means re-setting Prepare.
The watcher fires on EVERY change of the field, so the gate lets only Prepare through. It flips the lease to Awaiting Approval at once (cannot be picked twice) and starts ONE child execution per lease, because the child sleeps on a Slack reply and a sleeping execution can only hold one conversation.
